finding.claim: A remote schema fetched via --url can make the generator read arbitrary local files through a file:// $ref, because allow_remote_refs is forced True and the file:// branch skips containment and scheme checks.
finding.source: Attacker-controlled $ref strings in a schema body served over HTTP(S) and fetched with --url.

trace.note: base_url set; relative refs joined via join_url; absolute file:// ref assumed to pass through unchanged (httpx join behaviour not confirmed)
allow_remote_refs block/warning applies only to http/https; file:// skips it
_resolve_local_ref_path returns resolved path without containment when allow_remote_refs is True

finding.guards_checked: http.py _validate_url_for_fetch (scheme/host/IP checks) runs only on the HTTP fetch path and never sees file://; allow_remote_refs=False would block (jsonschema.py:10932) but is not the default for --url; YAML uses SafeLoader (_source.py:162) so no code execution, but file reads are not restricted.

finding.claim: Local schema $ref targets outside the input directory are read by default; the containment check only emits a deprecation warning when allow_remote_refs is None (the default).
finding.source: A $ref containing ../ in any schema under the input directory (e.g. checked in from an untrusted repository or pull request).
finding.sink: jsonschema.py:11105 _load_ref_data_from_path (local file read outside input base path).

trace.note: allow_remote_refs None -> warn_deprecated and return out-of-base path

finding.guards_checked: Containment check exists but only warns by default; blocking requires --no-allow-remote-refs.

finding.claim: Possible write outside the output directory: module paths derived from out-of-base refs keep '..' components and are joined to the output directory without a containment check. Unverified: the step that sets DataModel.file_path from the ref path was not located.
finding.source: Out-of-base $ref (see F2) producing a model whose file_path contains '..'.
finding.sink: __init__.py:1521-1534 output.joinpath(*name), mkdir and open('wt') for each generated module.

trace.note: resolve_ref joins local file path without containment
get_relative_path emits '..' components for targets outside base
get_module_path keeps file_path.parts unsanitized (only stem sanitized)

finding.guards_checked: __main__.py:2311-2324 escape check appears to be batch/job-only; single-run path not confirmed to lack a check. DataModel.file_path origin (model/base.py:2083) not traced to its caller.

finding.claim: _get_regex_literal catches only SyntaxError from ast.literal_eval; a NUL byte in a schema pattern raises ValueError on Python < 3.12 and aborts generation (availability only, no injection).
finding.source: A schema pattern string containing a NUL byte.
finding.guards_checked: literal_eval validation ensures only a single string literal reaches generated source, so no code injection.
